# TableMap { #timetoalign.TableMap }

```python
TableMap(
    x_values,
    y_values,
    kind=InterpolationKind.linear,
    extrapolate=ExtrapolationPolicy.extrapolate,
    source_unit=None,
    target_unit=None,
    uid=None,
    name=None,
)
```

Lookup table with interpolation between anchor points.

A TableMap defines a mapping using explicit (x, y) pairs. Values
between pairs are interpolated according to the specified method.

This is useful for:
- Tempo-based time conversions (ticks to seconds with varying tempo)
- Alignment anchors
- Any non-linear monotonic mapping

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name        | Type                                                                                                   | Description                                          |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| x_values    | [NDArray](`numpy.typing.NDArray`)\[[np](`numpy`).[floating](`numpy.floating`)\[[Any](`typing.Any`)\]\] | The input coordinates (must be strictly increasing). |
| y_values    | [NDArray](`numpy.typing.NDArray`)\[[np](`numpy`).[floating](`numpy.floating`)\[[Any](`typing.Any`)\]\] | The corresponding output values.                     |
| kind        | [InterpolationKind](`timetoalign.core.enums.InterpolationKind`)                                        | The interpolation method.                            |
| extrapolate | [InterpolationKind](`timetoalign.core.enums.InterpolationKind`)                                        | How to handle out-of-bounds inputs.                  |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Simple tempo map: 0 ticks = 0 sec, 480 ticks = 0.5 sec, 960 ticks = 1.5 sec
>>> tempo_map = TableMap(
...     x_values=[0, 480, 960],
...     y_values=[0.0, 0.5, 1.5],
...     source_unit="ticks",
...     target_unit="seconds",
... )
>>> tempo_map(240)  # Interpolate: 0.25 sec
0.25
>>> tempo_map(720)  # Interpolate: 1.0 sec
1.0
```

```python
>>> # Inverse map
>>> inverse = tempo_map.inverse()
>>> inverse(1.0)
720.0
```

### from_tempo_changes { #timetoalign.TableMap.from_tempo_changes }

```python
TableMap.from_tempo_changes(
    tick_positions,
    tempos_bpm,
    ticks_per_quarter=480,
    source_unit='ticks',
    target_unit='seconds',
)
```

Create a TableMap from MIDI-style tempo changes.

This is a convenience constructor for the common case of converting
MIDI ticks to seconds based on tempo information.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type                                                          | Description                                                                       | Default     |
|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| tick_positions    | [Sequence](`typing.Sequence`)\[[int](`int`)\]                 | Tick positions where tempo changes occur.            First should typically be 0. | _required_  |
| tempos_bpm        | [Sequence](`typing.Sequence`)\[[float](`float`)\]             | Tempo in BPM at each position.                                                    | _required_  |
| ticks_per_quarter | [int](`int`)                                                  | MIDI resolution (ticks per quarter note).                                         | `480`       |
| source_unit       | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`) | Source unit name.                                                                 | `'ticks'`   |
| target_unit       | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) \| [str](`str`) | Target unit name.                                                                 | `'seconds'` |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                          | Description                               |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
|        | [TableMap](`timetoalign.maps.table.TableMap`) | A TableMap for tick-to-second conversion. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Tempo starts at 120 BPM, changes to 60 BPM at tick 960
>>> tempo_map = TableMap.from_tempo_changes(
...     tick_positions=[0, 960],
...     tempos_bpm=[120.0, 60.0],
...     ticks_per_quarter=480,
... )
```

### inverse { #timetoalign.TableMap.inverse }

```python
TableMap.inverse()
```

|        | [Self](`typing_extensions.Self`) | A new TableMap with swapped coordinates. |

| Name   | Type                                         | Description                             |
|--------|----------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
